What is Thùng nhựa?

In this glossary, Thùng nhựa refers to: A rigid plastic box used for the storage and transport of dangerous goods, offering lightweight protection and chemical resistance.

Why does Thùng nhựa matter in logistics?

Thùng nhựa matters because it supports clear communication in Dangerous Goods contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A rigid plastic box used for the storage and transport of dangerous goods, offering lightweight protection and chemical resistance.

Operational example

Plastic crates are selected for certain dangerous goods shipments due to their resistance to corrosion and ease of cleaning.
